110	// ── Reading a file the closed way ────────────────────────────────────────────
111	
112	// readGateYAML reads one file of an overlay and returns the mapping at the top of
113	// its only document. A reason says why it cannot be judged, and the node is nil.
114	func readGateYAML(file string, maxBytes int64) (*yaml.Node, string) {
115		data, reason := readGateFile(file, maxBytes)
116		if reason != "" {
117			return nil, reason
118		}
119		return parseGateYAML(data)
120	}
121	
122	// readGateFile reads a regular file of at most maxBytes.
123	func readGateFile(file string, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, string) {
124		maxBytes = max(maxBytes, 0)
125		info, err := os.Stat(file)
126		if err != nil {
127			return nil, "it cannot be read (" + errReason(err) + ")"
128		}
129		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
130			return nil, "it is not a regular file"
131		}
132		tooBig := fmt.Sprintf("it is larger than %d bytes", maxBytes)
133		if info.Size() > maxBytes {
134			return nil, tooBig
135		}
136		f, err := os.Open(file) //nolint:gosec // a file of the repository being scanned, vetted above
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, "it cannot be read (" + errReason(err) + ")"
139		}
140		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
141		// The size may have changed since the stat: one byte more says it did.
142		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(f, maxBytes+1))
143		if err != nil {
144			return nil, "it cannot be read (" + errReason(err) + ")"
145		}
146		if int64(len(data)) > maxBytes {
147			return nil, tooBig
148		}
149		return data, ""
150	}

152	// errReason is err without the path an os error carries.
153	func errReason(err error) string {
154		var pathErr *fs.PathError
155		if errors.As(err, &pathErr) {
156			return pathErr.Err.Error()
157		}
158		return err.Error()
159	}
160	
161	// reasonNoDocument is the reason for a file with nothing in it but comments.
162	const reasonNoDocument = "it holds no YAML document"
163	
164	// parseGateYAML returns the mapping at the top of the only document of data.
165	func parseGateYAML(data []byte) (*yaml.Node, string) {
166		dec := yaml.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
167		var doc yaml.Node
168		if err := dec.Decode(&doc); err != nil {
169			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
170				return nil, reasonNoDocument
171			}
172			return nil, "it is not valid YAML"
173		}
174		var next yaml.Node
175		if err := dec.Decode(&next); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
176			return nil, "it holds more than one YAML document"
177		}
178		if doc.Kind != yaml.DocumentNode || len(doc.Content) != 1 || doc.Content[0].Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
179			return nil, "its top level is not a mapping"
180		}
181		top := doc.Content[0]
182		if problem := nodeProblem(top); problem != "" {
183			return nil, "it holds " + problem
184		}
185		return top, ""
186	}
187	
188	// nodeProblem names what makes a node something the gate does not read: kustomize
189	// resolves anchors, aliases and merge keys, applies tags, matches field names
190	// without regard to case (and, for a non-ASCII letter, to Unicode folding) and
191	// keeps the last of two equal keys, so a reading that does not do the same is
192	// not a reading of what kustomize will do.
193	func nodeProblem(n *yaml.Node) string {
194		switch {
195		case n.Kind == yaml.AliasNode:
196			return "an alias"
197		case n.Anchor != "":
198			return "an anchor"
199		case n.Style&yaml.TaggedStyle != 0:
200			return "an explicit tag"
201		}
202		switch n.Kind {
203		case yaml.MappingNode:
204			seen := map[string]bool{}
205			for i := 0; i+1 < len(n.Content); i += 2 {
206				key := n.Content[i]
207				if problem := keyProblem(key, seen); problem != "" {
208					return problem
209				}
210				if problem := nodeProblem(n.Content[i+1]); problem != "" {
211					return problem
212				}
213			}
214		case yaml.SequenceNode:
215			for _, c := range n.Content {
216				if problem := nodeProblem(c); problem != "" {
217					return problem
218				}
219			}
220		}
221		return ""
222	}
223	
224	func keyProblem(key *yaml.Node, seen map[string]bool) string {
225		if problem := nodeProblem(key); problem != "" {
226			return problem
227		}
228		switch {
229		case key.Kind == yaml.ScalarNode && key.Value == "<<":
230			return "a merge key"
231		case key.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || key.Tag != "!!str":
232			return "a key that is not a string"
233		}
234		for i := 0; i < len(key.Value); i++ {
235			if key.Value[i] >= 0x80 {
236				return "a key that is not ASCII"
237			}
238		}
239		folded := strings.ToLower(key.Value)
240		if seen[folded] {
241			return "a duplicate key"
242		}
243		seen[folded] = true
244		return ""
245	}
